description.value: The Regent Hotel is a family-owned boutique heritage hotel in downtown Revelstoke, operating continuously since 1945 and originally built in the 1920s as two separate hotels (the Windsor and the Selkirk). Its unique, character-filled rooms, on-site pub, restaurant, sauna, and outdoor hot tub make it a full-service base for exploring Revelstoke's world-class mountain biking, hiking, and outdoor adventures. Pets are welcome, and the downtown location puts guests within easy reach of the town's shops, cafés, and trailheads.
